target.title: Nanocalcs
target.description: Exact calculators (loans, dates, units, LLM tokens, API cost, VRAM) + prefilled nanocalcs.com links

checks.summary: Listed in the MCP Registry as com.nanocalcs/calculators.

observation.network_policy: sinkhole: DNS is answered with placeholder addresses and every TCP connection and UDP datagram is captured inside the sandbox; nothing leaves it

tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Search the 431 free calculators and converters on nanocalcs.com by keyword (any language). Returns id, name, page URL, accepted prefill parameters and an example prefilled URL. Use the id with build_link to give the user a page with their own numbers filled in.

tools.name: build_link
tools.description: Build a nanocalcs.com URL for a tool id with inputs pre-filled via query parameters. Values are validated against the tool's parameter spec (ranges, allowed values, dates); invalid or unknown parameters are rejected with the accepted list. Give the returned url to the user.

tools.name: percentage
tools.description: Exact percentage math. mode "of": a% of b. mode "what": a is what % of b. mode "change": percent change from a to b. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: loan_payment
tools.description: Monthly loan repayment, total interest and total paid. type annuity (equal payments, default), principal (equal principal) or bullet (interest-only, principal at the end). The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: date_add
tools.description: Add or subtract years, months, weeks and days from a date (month-end clamped: Jan 31 + 1 month = Feb 28/29). The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: days_between
tools.description: Number of days, weeks, and years/months/days between two dates. inclusive counts the end date too. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: age
tools.description: Exact age in years, months and days, total days, and the next birthday. on defaults to today (UTC). The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: unit_convert
tools.description: Convert units with exact definitional factors. Units by category: length: mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, yd, mi, nmi; mass: mg, g, kg, t, oz, lb, st, ton_us, ton_uk; temperature: c, f, k, r; volume: ml, l, m3, tsp, tbsp, floz, cup, pt, qt, gal, pt_uk, gal_uk, in3, ft3; area: cm2, m2, ha, km2, in2, ft2, yd2, ac, mi2; speed: mps, kph, mph, fps, kn; time: ms, s, min, h, d, wk, mo, yr; data: bit, B, kB, MB, GB, TB, KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB, Mbit, Gbit. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust t

tools.name: bmi
tools.description: Body mass index with WHO adult category and the healthy weight range for the height (metric). The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: roi
tools.description: Total ROI %, profit, multiple, and annualized (compound) return when a period is given. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: token_count
tools.description: Exact token count with OpenAI tiktoken encodings (o200k_base default, cl100k_base), plus Claude and Gemini estimates. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: context_window_fit
tools.description: Whether a prompt fits each model's context window, with remaining tokens after an output reserve. Give tokens, or text to count with o200k_base. Omit model to check all listed models. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: llm_api_cost
tools.description: API cost per request, day, month and year from list prices. Omit model to get the 10 cheapest. Models: gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.5, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5-mini, gpt-4.1, gpt-4o-mini, claude-fable-5.1, claude-opus-5.5, claude-sonnet-5.5, claude-haiku-5.5, claude-haiku-4.5, gemini-3.1-pro, gemini-3-flash, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-2.5-flash-lite, mistral-large-3, mistral-medium-3.5, mistral-small-4, deepseek-flash-off, deepseek-flash-peak, deepseek-pro-off, deepseek-pro-peak. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pr

tools.name: gpu_vram
tools.description: VRAM needed to run a local LLM: weights + KV cache + overhead, and which common GPU sizes fit. Use a preset (llama31-8b, llama31-70b, qwen25-7b, qwen25-14b, qwen25-32b, qwen25-72b, qwen3-8b, qwen3-32b, mistral-7b, mistral-nemo, gemma2-9b, gemma2-27b, phi4-14b) or give params_b, layers, kv_heads, head_dim. Defaults: bits 4, context 8192, batch 1, kv_bits 16, overhead_pct 10. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: relative_date
tools.description: Turn an English relative date phrase into an exact calendar date: "next Tuesday", "in 3 weeks", "10 business days from today", "third Friday of March 2027", "last day of February 2028". Returns the date, weekday, how the phrase was read and alternative readings for ambiguous phrases. Use this instead of doing calendar math in your head. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: business_days
tools.description: Count business (working) days between two dates, or add/subtract N business days from a date, skipping weekends and given holidays. Give end to count, or days to add (negative to go back). The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: schengen_90_180
tools.description: Schengen short-stay rule: days used in the rolling 180-day window, days left, overstay check, how long you can stay from a date and the next possible entry. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: due_date
tools.description: Estimated due date, current gestational age (weeks+days), trimester and days left. method lmp (last menstrual period, default), conception, ivf3, ivf5 (embryo transfer date) or us (ultrasound date with us_weeks/us_days). The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: time_zone_convert
tools.description: Convert a local date and time in one IANA time zone to other zones, with UTC offsets, abbreviations, DST status and day shifts (IANA tz data, DST aware). The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: compound_interest
tools.description: Future value with compound interest and optional regular deposits, total interest, APY and year-by-year balance. Defaults: monthly compounding, monthly deposits at period end. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: bmi_for_age
tools.description: Child and teen BMI percentile and z-score from WHO growth references (0-19 y, default) or CDC charts (2-20 y), with the weight category and healthy BMI range. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: molar_mass
tools.description: Molar mass (g/mol) and mass percent composition of a chemical formula, with parentheses and hydrates (e.g. Ca(OH)2, CuSO4*5H2O), using standard atomic weights. Optionally convert grams to moles or moles to grams. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: ap_score
tools.description: Estimate an AP exam score (1-5) from multiple-choice correct answers and free-response points, using published scoring worksheet weights. Subjects: apush, world, lang, lit, bio, chem, calcab, calcbc, stats, psych, gov, phys1. The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

tools.name: sat_score
tools.description: Digital SAT scaled score range (400-1600) from correct answers per module, using official Bluebook practice test conversion tables (tests 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11; default the latest). The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.

sandbox: Network: container namespace of the sinkhole (no route out).
limits: Install ran in a separate container with unrestricted network access (to fetch the package), with install scripts and source builds disabled.
File reads are not recorded; writes are measured against the freshly installed image.
Writes to tmpfs mounts such as /dev/shm are not visible.
Only tools declared read-only (or named with --safe-tool) were called, with synthetic inputs; every other tool's behaviour is unobserved.
Effects are attributed to the phase in which they appeared; background activity can land in a neighbouring phase.
One short session was observed; delayed or conditional behaviour may not have triggered.
Rewrites of files already changed in an earlier phase are detected by size and modification time while the server runs; a rewrite that keeps both, or one during shutdown, is not seen.
Non-DNS UDP is counted without its destination.

headline: No mismatches observed in the sandbox. That is evidence, not a guarantee.

suggestions.title: Pinned launch entry
suggestions.note: Generated from published metadata with the exact version. MCPAudit never reads or edits your client configuration; paste it yourself after review.

suggestions.title: Tool permissions (Claude Code settings)
suggestions.note: allow: declared read-only and called successfully with no effects seen. deny: declared destructive, injection-matching, or a high-severity mismatch. ask: everything not proven either way.

suggestions.title: Network egress
suggestions.note: Hosts are attempts recorded by the sinkhole; none were reached. Allow only what the tools you use need.

suggestions.title: Filesystem writes
suggestions.note: Paths are where it wrote during the observed session; reads were not recorded.
